summary: After upgrading, controller admins become platform admins who can administer hub; a 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade with private hub shows an in-product dialog for reconfiguring hub, and controller-only environments need roles added to grant hub and EDA access.
questions: Can controller admins manage automation hub after upgrading to 2.6?
What is the post-upgrade dialog about private automation hub?
How do users get access to hub and EDA after upgrading a controller-only install?
